title: gelseminum gaudichaudii
intro: Gelseminum gaudichaudii, commonly known as New Caledonian gelsemium, is a plant species in the family Gelsemiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in medicine and has been found to have various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gelsemium gaudichaudii include its sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids. The primary bioactive constituents of Gelsemium gaudichaudii include gelsemine, gelsemicine, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
